Answer: <0 or 1>

prediction.raw: I think the answer is 1 (You are the asshole). Here's why: As a parent, it's understandable that you want to ensure your 14-year-old daughter is well taken care of while you're away. However, expecting your 22-year-old son to put his life on hold for an entire month to watch his sister is unreasonable. Your son has his own life, plans, and responsibilities, and it's not fair to expect him to sacrifice his freedom and autonomy to babysit his sister full-time. It's also not his responsibility to take care of his sister at all times, especially since he has his own work and personal commitments. Hiring a babysitter or exploring other childcare options, as your son suggested, is a more reasonable and fair solution. This would allow your son to maintain his independence and pursue his own plans, while also ensuring your daughter is well cared for. By expecting your son to take on this significant responsibility without considering his own needs and plans, you're being unfair and potentially damaging your relationship with him. It's essential to find a solution that balances your daughter's needs with your son's autonomy and independence.
